macros.name: DTLbaratendtikz
macros.doc: Hook implemented at the end of the tikzpicture environment.

macros.name: DTLbarchart
macros.doc: Draws a bar chart from the data given in the database identified by ⟨db-name⟩.

macros.name: DTLbarchart
macros.doc: Draws a bar chart from the data given in the database identified by ⟨db-name⟩.

macros.name: DTLbarchartwidth
macros.doc: Used to store the total width of the x-axis.

macros.name: DTLbardisplayYticklabel
macros.doc: \DTLbardisplayYticklabel governs how the y tick labels appear.

macros.name: DTLbargroupindex
macros.doc: Placeholder command that expands to the current bar group index (starting from 1).

macros.name: DTLbargrouplabelalign
macros.doc: Alignment for group label.

macros.name: DTLbarindex
macros.doc: Placeholder command that expands to the current bar index (starting from 1).

macros.name: DTLbarmax
macros.doc: The maximum value of the y axis.

macros.name: DTLBarStyle
macros.doc: Any additional styling for each bar.

macros.name: DTLbartotalvariables
macros.doc: Used to store the total number of variables for multi charts.

macros.name: DTLbarvalue
macros.doc: Placeholder command that may be used in lower or upper labels to show the bar value as a formatted number that has been rounded according to the round setting.

macros.name: DTLbarwidth
macros.doc: The width of each bar is given by \DTLbarwidth.

macros.name: DTLBarXAxisStyle
macros.doc: The expansion text of this command should be the tikz line style specifier for the x-axis.

macros.name: DTLbarXlabelalign
macros.doc: Alignment for lower bar labels.

macros.name: DTLbarXneglabelalign
macros.doc: This command should expand to the \pgftext alignment specifications for the x-axis lower bar labels for negative values.

macros.name: DTLbarXupperlabelalign
macros.doc: This command should expand to the \pgftext alignment specifications for the upper bar labels.

macros.name: DTLBarYAxisStyle
macros.doc: The style of the y axis is given by \DTLBarYAxisStyle.

macros.name: DTLbarYticklabelalign
macros.doc: Alignment for y tick labels.

macros.name: DTLclearbarcolors
macros.doc: Clears all bar colours.

macros.name: DTLclearnegbarcolors
macros.doc: Clears all negative bar colours.

macros.name: DTLdisplaybargrouplabel
macros.doc: \DTLdisplaybargrouplabel governs how the bar group labels appear.

macros.name: DTLdisplaylowerbarlabel
macros.doc: \DTLdisplaylowerbarlabel governs how the lower bar labels appear.

macros.name: DTLdisplaylowermultibarlabel
macros.doc: This command encapsulates the lower bar labels for \DTLmultibarchart.

macros.name: DTLdisplayupperbarlabel
macros.doc: \DTLdisplayupperbarlabel governs how the upper bar labels appear.

macros.name: DTLdisplayuppermultibarlabel
macros.doc: This command encapsulates the upper bar labels for \DTLmultibarchart.

macros.name: DTLdobarcolor
macros.doc: Sets the colour to that for the ⟨n⟩th bar.

macros.name: DTLdobarcolor
macros.doc: Sets the colour to that for the ⟨n⟩th bar.

macros.name: DTLeverybargrouphook
macros.doc: Hook implemented after every bar group is drawn with \DTLmultibarchart.

macros.name: DTLeverybarhook
macros.doc: Code to apply at every bar after the bar has been drawn.

macros.name: DTLeveryprebarhook
macros.doc: Code to apply at every bar before the bar has been drawn.

macros.name: DTLgetbarcolor
macros.doc: Gets the colour specification for the ⟨n⟩th bar.

macros.name: DTLgetnegbarcolor
macros.doc: Gets the negative bar colour specification for the ⟨n⟩th bar.

macros.name: DTLmultibarchart
macros.doc: Make a multi-bar chart from data given in data base ⟨db name⟩, where ⟨assign list⟩ is a comma-separated list of ⟨cmd⟩=⟨key⟩ pairs.

macros.name: DTLmultibarchart
macros.doc: Make a multi-bar chart from data given in data base ⟨db name⟩, where ⟨assign list⟩ is a comma-separated list of ⟨cmd⟩=⟨key⟩ pairs.

macros.name: DTLsetbarcolor
macros.doc: Assigns colour name ⟨color⟩ to the ⟨n⟩th bar.

macros.name: DTLsetnegbarcolor
macros.doc: Assigns colour name ⟨color⟩ to the ⟨n⟩th bar for negative bar values.

macros.name: DTLtotalbargroups
macros.doc: Used to store the total number of bar groups for multi charts.

macros.name: DTLtotalbars
macros.doc: This expands to the total number of bars in the current chart (and to nothing outside of the bar chart commands).
